name: Memory Match
hook: Flip two. Find the pair. Go again.
how: On your turn flip two cards. A matching pair is yours and you go again; a miss turns them back and passes the turn. When the board is empty, most pairs wins.
controls: Click or tap a card to flip it (arrows + Space work too)
uses: The host's browser checks every flip and runs the turns; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
A bot takes the empty seat when you're alone, remembering some of the cards it has seen.
The host shuffles from a seed, so every screen deals the same board and sees every flip.
Pairs found, added up over every game, shown after each game.
ideas: Make the board 6 by 6 with 18 pairs
Add a shuffle card that moves every face-down card
Use animal faces instead of shapes
